_comment: Model registry for the TIH crop-research classification benchmark.
Contains model provenance, external benchmark metrics, and references.
External metrics are NOT our cauliflower results — they are from the source library/paper.
Our cauliflower results are stored in output/benchmark/<model>/test_eval/ and
referenced here via 'our_results.eval_dir' once training is complete.
Add future models by inserting a new key under 'models'.

resnet50.name: ResNet-50
resnet50.paper: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
resnet50.paper_authors: He, K., Zhang, X., Ren, S., Sun, J.

external_metrics._comment: Metrics from the torchvision model documentation (IMAGENET1K_V2 recipe). Do NOT confuse with our cauliflower results.

resnet50.parameter_count_source: torchvision documentation and sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())

our_results._comment: Populated after training. Full 50-epoch results will update this field. Metrics are NOT duplicated here — the canonical record is in the eval_dir below.
